Thatch is assigned Jimmy’s house, and has a hard time escaping from Graham! Whilst Casper is at an old lady’s house, and of course he can’t bear to scare the old dear. But Casper will have to do SOMETHING as they are watched by the gargoyles AND there’s the added problem of a mysterious garden gnome thief seemingly running wild… The Little Dragon ‐ It’s show and tell in science class. Rooting about in the Secret Attic Casper finds a dragon egg and brings it to Prof. Burns’ class. The teacher is thrilled! He’s not seen a dragon’s egg in 600 years! and he fetches the headmasters. The dragon’s birth is imminent, all are on tenderhooks!. Thatch sneakily steals the egg but loses it by accident. Professor Burns is furious! Casper and his friends must find the egg as soon as possible because if it does hatch and if the dragon eats something sweet, it will grow to GIGANTIC proportions and become a city destroying BEAST!! Casper must prevent a disaster from happening in Deedstown.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When the trees start losing their leaves, Phoebe begins knitting the trees in the park sweaters, but when the neighborhood kids see the sweaters they think they're a mysterious "Yarn Fairy," and they want to see her in action, making it much harder for the Dews to put more sweaters on the latest trees that have lost their leaves. / When Marcus and Harper team-up for a school project, they decide to bake something ("It's like inventing, but with food!"), only to come across multiple baking misshaps (and happy accidents) along the way that the Dew Drops must secretly assist them with.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When "something" starts snatching things and causing havoc in Marcus' house, Phoebe and the Dew Drops investigate only to find that it's a stray kitten that they need to catch and find a home for before Marcus returns home. But in the end, Marcus decides to take the kitty in, as his own. / Lola isn't very good at “Hide & Seek” so the Dew Drops help her improve her game. But she becomes so good that no one can find her! And now she’s going to be late to her own surprise tea party!

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal
programme.desc: Kelp has a new trick with his bubbles: he can have his friends put voice messages inside that you hear when you pop them. But when Pixie decides she doesn’t want the others to hear what’s in her bubble, the chase is on to rescue it! / Juniper is devastated when the traditional ceremony to celebrate her next level of spark achievement can’t happen. Kelp helps introduce a new tradition.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal
programme.desc: Kelp writes a song about him and Scallop to perform at the unicorn show. programme.desc: Boss Baby is framed for leaking info about the Stinkless Serum to PuppyCo and must flee on the run via Errand Day with the family

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business
programme.desc: Tim and Boss Baby want to bond with Dad by recreating a perfect "Dudes Weekend' camping trip, culminating in a photo opp, but everything seems to go wrong

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business
programme.desc: When Tim is forced to take piano lessons, he actually enjoys them and Boss Baby realizes that Tim is being brainwashed by his piano teacher, slowly turning Tim into an old man

programme.title: All Hail King Julien: Exiled

programme.title: All Hail King Julien

programme.title: Harvey Girls Forever!
programme.desc: Lotta must infiltrate the Bloogey's treehouse by going undercover and pretending to be a boy. / Fredo throws a block-wide puzzle hunt

programme.title: Dinotrux
programme.desc: When Flapjaw the Pteracopter's landing gear is damaged by Dyscrapadons, the Trux have to come up with a plan to repair him in midair.

programme.title: Dinotrux
programme.desc: When the Trux meet another group of Trux who look just like them but have different personalities, they team up to fool D-Structs and D-Stroy.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots
programme.desc: Puss is terrified by an invasion by a swarm of bees, which only the hippy-like “Piper” can control with her magic flute.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots
programme.desc: Just as Puss is training the orphans to protect San Lorenzo, El Moco storms into town and cat-naps the swashbuckling hero.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go!
programme.desc: When Mom is sick on a busy day at home, Tag offers to pick up the slack and take on her tasks for the day. Tag handles it at first, but when the responsibilities start to stack up, she realizes that being Mom is much harder than she thought. \ Tag and Scooch are excited to get to know Kit, who has organized a bunch of cat-ivities for the day. But when Kit realizes she accidentally scratched up Frank and Beans’s tree, she, Tag and Scooch find a way to make it up to them.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: 2500 Candles for Ra Upset that no one remembered his birthday, Ra goes to hang out with the mummies at the Deedstown museum. It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Underworld When Casper finds Cappy's old treasure map, he promises to help the pirate find his lost fortune.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Curse of the Sandwich After Ra accidentally bites into Thatch's sandwich, he becomes convinced that he's turning into a vampire. Real Little Monster When Norman the bully comes after Jimmy, Casper helps his human friend hide in the one place he knows Norman won't look—Scare School.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go
programme.desc: Ari moves in to Harmony Harbor, but notices something strange involving a group of kids, a Noodle Truck chef and her pet squirrel. / After Ari discovers the secret of Team Zenko Go, he asks to join the crew. But first he must learn the importance of teamwork.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go
programme.desc: When Donna's delivery truck breaks down, it's up to the crew to help Donna continue delivering packages to Harmony Harbor's residents. / When the crew takes on a mission to rescue a lost pet, Ellie must face her fears in order to help save the day.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia’s class is learning to how to square-dance, and Olivia is thrilled. She’s less thrilled, however, to be partnered with clumsy Harold Hockenberry, who seems to have two left feet. But when Olivia learns what a skilled gardener Harold is, she incorporates gardening into their square-dance, with fabulous results!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Everyone is in Olivia’s family is disappointed when their cruise is cancelled after Ian breaks out in a strange rash. Nevertheless, Olivia is determined to show her family a good time. With an inflatable pirate ship bounce house, Olivia takes her family and friends on the backyard cruise of their lives.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia finds the perfect birthday present for Francine in a box of cereal – a pink charm bracelet! But when it accidentally falls down the drain, Olivia has to scramble to find an alternative: using trinkets that recall some of their favorite memories together, Olivia makes her own charm bracelet for a delighted Francine.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia is thrilled when she’s chosen to build the mascot snowman –or in her case, snowlady – for the annual Maywood winter festival. She’s determined to build the biggest snowman anybody’s ever seen! But when all the snow melts away, Olivia has to build her snowlady out of something else: cotton candy!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: The Black Cat ‐ Jimmy has had enough of his bully Norman, so he and Casper decide to teach Norman a lesson and get him over to the Manor for some REAL scaring. But things don't go to plan when one of Stretch’s potion vials accidentally breaks and the potion changes into a black cat! In the cat’s body Norman gives bad luck to anyone who tries to approach him! It's a tough one for Casper —not an easy catch, to say the least! Jimmy The Ghost ‐ A magic lantern that Casper finds in the Manor, turns Jimmy into a ghost. At last he can do everything Casper does — how awesome! But you don’t learn about being a ghost in just one day. Jimmy seems to enjoy his new ghostly powers a bit too much, which ends up putting Casper in a tricky situation and puts Jimmy face to face with Graham the ghost‐catcher – AKA HIS DAD!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Woodward's Day Out ‐ While visiting Cappy the Pirate, Casper learns that Woodward, the figurehead from Cappy’s Galleon, has disappeared during a storm above Deedstown. Casper and Jimmy go looking for him throughout the city and start to uncover the strange path Woodward has taken, but will they rescue Woodward before he’s mistaken for fire‐wood? Calc The Cameleon ‐ Casper, who causes Calculizard to lose his tail, finds him a new one in the Secret Attic. However this new tail is very special – in fact it’s charmed ‐ as it comes from a camelemonster and has the power to turn the wearer invisible. Calculizard is delighted with his new found power and decides visit the Deedstown movie theatre and indulge in his love of black and white movies. programme.desc: Discover the parts and functions of the sense organs of the human body; parts and functions of animals and plants and their importance to humans; the characteristics of living and nonliving things and the basic needs of plants, animals and humans.

programme.title: Grade 6 Filipino
programme.desc: Alamin ang iba't ibang uri pang-abay, ang kayarian at kailanan ng pang-uri, at aspekto at pokus ng pandiwa. Alamin rin kung paano sumuri ng talaarawan, anekdota, sanaysay at teksto.

programme.title: Grade 6 Math
programme.desc: Learn about order of operations, ratio and proportion, percent, exponents, and integers.

programme.title: Grade 6 English
programme.desc: Identify different aspects of verbs, modals, conjunctions, point of views, and viewing materials.

programme.title: Grade 6 Araling Panlipunan
programme.desc: Aralin ang mga pagbabago sa lipunang Pilipino sa panahon ng kolonyalismong Amerikano at ng pananakop ng mga Hapon at ang pagpupunyagi ng mga Pilipino na makamtan ang kalayaan tungo sa pagkabuo ng kamalayang pagsasarili at pagkakakilanlang malayang nasyon at estado.

programme.title: Grade 6 Science
programme.desc: Learn how the major organs of the human body work together to form organ systems, the different characteristics of vertebrates and invertebrates and the interactions for survival among living and nonliving things.

programme.title: Grade 8 Filipino
programme.desc: Matuto kung paano magsulat at bumuo ng mga tanong, argumento, tula, at maikling kuwento. Alamin rin kung paano magbigay ng kahulugan sa mga salita, simbolo at pahiwatig, at interpretasyon sa mga nabasang teksto.

programme.title: Grade 8 Math
programme.desc: Discover the key concepts of linear inequalities in two variables, systems of linear inequalities in two variables and linear functions, logic and reasoning.

programme.title: Grade 8 English
programme.desc: Learn about visual-verbal relationships and opinion-marking signals, as well as comparing and contrasting presentations, opinions, and messages.

programme.title: Grade 8 Araling Panlipunan
programme.desc: Aralin ang kontribusyon ng mga pangyayari sa klasiko at transisyunal na panahon sa pagkabuo at pagkahubog ng pagkakakilanlan ng mga bansa at rehiyon sa daigdig.

programme.title: Grade 8 Science
programme.desc: Identify the relationship between faults and earthquakes, learn about the formation of typhoons and their movement within the PAR, and the characteristics of comets, meteors, and asteroids.

programme.title: Preschool | Eccd
programme.desc: Learn and appreciate the Creator and the Creations, Communication, Cooperation, Relationship, Sense of Purpose

programme.title: Kindergarten
programme.desc: Learn about the concept of a family, school, and community, as well as letter names, sounds, and different vocabularies about the environment.

programme.title: Grade 1 Language
programme.desc: Matuto tungkol sa pabula at alamat at ang pagkasunod-sunod ng mga pangyayari nito. Alamin rin ang wastong paggamit ng magagalang na pananalita, pangngalan, malalaki at maliliit na letra, pati na rin ang pagbasa at pagbilang ng mga pantig.

programme.title: Grade 1 Math
programme.desc: Learn how to add and subtract whole numbers up to 100 including money.

programme.title: Grade 1 Reading & Literacy
programme.desc: Identify what are action words and describing words, and know how to follow and give directions involving one to two steps.

programme.title: The Humboldt Current
programme.desc: In Chile's Torres del Paine melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current lowering its salinity. Rivers estuaries and wetlands are home to many wading birds and the countless inlets and bays are magnets for rare dolphins and orcas.

programme.title: The Humboldt Current
programme.desc: The Humboldt Current is slower than most ocean currents but it’s the most dynamic in the world because it travels for such a long distance. Upwelling from the deepest trenches brings nutrients to the surface allowing phytoplankton to bloom laying the foundation for an intricate marine food chain

programme.title: The Humboldt Current
programme.desc: The current is followed by a unique population of Chilean blue whales and is the last refuge for other extremely rare marine mammals. From the chill of its deepest depths to the wind on its highest cliffs the current creates unusual habitats and is a study in survival.
